new_information: Taiwan's CAA announced on August 21 that second-wave extra flights and upgraded aircraft for Penghu and Kinmen routes during Mid-Autumn and Teachers' Day holidays will open for booking on August 26 at 9 a.m.
The second-wave capacity additions will provide 4,920 seats for Penghu routes and 2,464 seats for Kinmen routes, totaling 7,384 additional seats.
Tickets for peak periods from Sept 24-26 outbound from Taiwan and Sept 27-29 return from offshore islands carry restrictions including valid only on designated flight date and void after expiration.
Initial regular flights and first-wave extra flights for the Mid-Autumn and Teachers' Day offshore island routes opened for booking on July 27.

sources.name: AeroTime — US appeals court allows Delta-Aeroméxico joint venture to c…

Reuters — Delta, Aeromexico win US court battle to keep joint venture

new_information: The 11th US Circuit Court of Appeals vacated a September 2025 Department of Transportation order on August 20, 2026, that required Delta Air Lines and Aeroméxico to dismantle their joint venture.
The ruling allows Delta Air Lines and Aeroméxico to continue coordinating schedules, fares, and capacity under antitrust immunity granted in 2016.

The court found the Department of Transportation's 2025 review focused primarily on Mexico City International Airport (MEX) without updating market share data or conducting country-pair and city-pair analyses.

The Department of Transportation had withdrawn approval following disputes over Mexican government policy, including slot reductions at MEX and moving cargo operations to Felipe Ángeles International Airport (NLU).
Aeroméxico welcomed the ruling and stated that the joint venture and its antitrust immunity remain in effect.
